name: Roaring Fur-nace
summaryText: The warm fire blazes through the long night, casting light on the tiger's roar in my heart.
descriptionText:
Goodbye to the fate of the past, goodbye to the childhood that slipped away so quickly, goodbye to my father's embrace and my mother's smile, goodbye to the claws and the stripes, goodbye to the unmoving mountains and the clouds that never linger, goodbye to my mentor and old friends, goodbye to me, goodbye to me.
As long as the world remembers, I once roared with courage.

"Never fear! Your senior is here!" —  Fufu's line when coming to the rescue.
